sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a traditional Indian tag game played on a rectangular field?
What does 'Pranayama' in Yoga primarily focus on?
In which local game do players hop on one foot through a numbered grid drawn on the ground?
Which yoga pose helps improve concentration and balance by standing on one leg?
Why is it important to perform stretching exercises before playing any game?
options: A) To feel sleepy and relaxed
B) To warm up muscles and prevent injuries
C) To get tired quickly before playing
D) To forget the game's rules
questions.answer: B) To warm up muscles and prevent injuries

questions.question_text: In the game of Kabaddi, what must the raider constantly chant while in the opponent's half?
Which sitting posture is commonly known as the Lotus Pose and used for meditation?
What is the main benefit of practicing Shavasana (Corpse Pose) at the end of a yoga session?
options: C) Deep body and mind relaxation
questions.answer: C) Deep body and mind relaxation

questions.question_text: How many players are there on the field for a single defending Kabaddi team?
Which traditional local game uses a small piece of wood and a larger wooden stick to hit it?
Explain the correct way to sit in Padmasana (Lotus Pose). [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed. Place your right foot on your left thigh and your left foot on your right thigh, keeping your back perfectly straight.

questions.question_text: State two important rules players must follow while raiding in the game of Kabaddi. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The raider must continuously chant "Kabaddi" in a single breath without stopping. The raider must also try to touch an opponent and safely return to their own half.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to play traditional local games with our friends? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Playing traditional games helps us stay physically active, teaches us valuable teamwork, and connects us to our rich cultural history while having fun outdoors with our friends.

questions.question_text: What is the benefit of doing deep breathing exercises (Pranayama) every morning? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Deep breathing exercises fill our lungs with fresh oxygen. This helps immediately calm our mind, improves our daily focus, and gives us energy for the entire day.

questions.question_text: How do players pass the turn to chase in the traditional game of Kho-Kho? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The active chaser taps the back of a sitting teammate and loudly says "Kho." The tapped player then immediately gets up to become the brand new chaser.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are participating in a Yoga Sadhana morning class. Describe how you would perform the Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose). [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would carefully lie on my stomach with my toes completely flat and my hands placed under my shoulders. Taking a deep breath, I would slowly lift my head and chest off the ground, looking up toward the sky while keeping my lower body pressed firmly to the mat.

questions.question_text: Imagine you and your friends are drawing a Hopscotch (Stapu) grid on the ground. Describe the grid and how you play the game. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: We draw large connecting squares on the ground and number them from one to eight. I toss a small stone into the first square, then carefully hop on one foot through the grid, skipping the square with the stone, and balance perfectly without stepping on the chalk lines.

questions.question_text: Explain how practicing Yoga daily helps a student improve both their physical health and their performance in school. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Practicing yoga daily makes the body highly flexible and strongly builds up the muscles, keeping students completely safe from common sickness. The careful balancing poses and deep breathing exercises greatly improve a child's concentration and memory. This calm focus helps students pay much better attention during classroom lessons and feel relaxed.

questions.question_text: Describe a situation in a local team game where good sportsmanship and honesty are more important than just winning. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: In a fast game of Kabaddi, a defender might accidentally scratch the raider. Good sportsmanship means immediately stopping the game to apologize and check if the player is hurt. Honesty is also admitting you were tagged out even if the referee completely missed it, because playing fairly is always better than cheating.
